fields.note: Index into mIconInstanceData (lines 514, 523). Layout: gap88[56] ends at 0xc0, then mObjectType at 0xc0, floatC4..floatD0 at 0xc4..0xd0, so this is at 0xd4.

fields.note: Read as mapArea->mMappableObjList (lines 500-501). Layout: mAreaId, qword10/18/20, mAreaIdx, dword2C, ctransform4f30 (CTransform4f assumed 0x30 bytes, consistent with the qword60 name), qword60, dword68, qword70, qword78, then this at 0x80.

fields.name: mFocusWorld
fields.note: Pointer, 8-byte aligned after the int at 0x28. Read at lines 491, 496.

fields.name: mCurrPlayerWorld
fields.note: Pointer after mFocusWorld. Read at line 530.

fields.name: mRenderDataBitfield
fields.note: First member; source comment says the 2nd bit is mIsReloadArea. Set with |= 2 at line 486.

fields.name: mMappableObjData

fields.name: mHintIconMat
fields.note: Layout from char gapB8[0x40] (0xb8 + 0x40). Read at lines 401, 417, 433. CAUTION: the next gap is named gapF8, which would put this field at 0xf8 as well, so the gap name conflicts with the arithmetic. Verify on a live dump.

fields.name: mHintIconScalar
fields.note: Layout 0x100 + char gapF8[0x560] = 0x660. The gap name gapF8 suggests 0xf8 instead, so this offset is unverified. Address taken at line 439.

fields.name: mScrollSpeed

fields.note: Follows mRenderPos (CVector3f). Assumes CVector3f is 12 bytes (three floats); main.cpp does not state that size. Read at lines 404, 420, 436, 455, 519, 522.
